svg.text: Checked by the daily run. The date used to count days and the day-counting method are TBD.
Day 150 closure letter is required. The effect of earlier completion or cancellation is still to be agreed.
TBD = requirement to gather. Solid arrows = data / control flow; dashed arrow = API response. Processing details are on page 2.
Power Automate blocks show logical responsibilities; the number of flows and CSV pickup / export timing are not yet decided.
